notes: Braun and Hogenberg Delft is in vol. 3 (1581); #1–#6 are copies of the same plate, #4 chosen for resolution and clean margins. #11 and #26 are the same Vermeer painting as #9. P3 alternatives: #13 and #14 (‘Gezichten op Nederlandsche Steden’, Rijksmuseum dates them only 1820–95, though #13 shows the Rotterdam Gate, demolished in the 1830s); #12 shows only a mill and sheds outside Delft. #18 is the Morspoort in Leiden, not Delft. #16 (Oostpoort photochrom, PD) is a good alternative for P4. Modern panoramas are only fair (hazy); #28 shows outer suburbs.
